actionable_steps.citation: Eradicate Immorality To Attain Immortality — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 33 (2000), 2000-09-10
actionable_steps.step: Speak sweetly and lovingly always; never indulge in criticism — criticism is the reflection, reaction and resound of your own wicked qualities.

actionable_steps.citation: Faults and failures — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 10 (1970), 1970-11-21
actionable_steps.step: Develop love, demonstrate love, draw love from your surroundings — that is the way to deserve leadership.

actionable_steps.citation: No bumps, no jumps — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 13 (1975 - 77), 1975-11-15
actionable_steps.step: Treat service as the school for leadership — put in years of sincere seva to people before seeking any position.

actionable_steps.citation: A flower at His feet — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 10 (1970), 1970-03-04
actionable_steps.step: If you hold any office or badge, never boss over others — respect everyone as worthy of the highest respect you are capable of.
Lead by being an exemplar — walk the spiritual path first, so others can tread it after you.

definition.citation: Eradicate Immorality To Attain Immortality — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 33 (2000), 2000-09-10
definition.quote: One who works for the progress of the nation is a nayaka (true leader).

discourses.citation: Eradicate Immorality To Attain Immortality — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 33 (2000), 2000-09-10
discourses.quote: Some people call themselves desha nayakas (leaders of the nation), but in practice they are desha nashakas (destroyers of the nation). One who works for the progress of the nation is a nayaka (true leader). One who calls himself a leader should always speak sweetly and lovingly.

discourses.citation: Faults and failures — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 10 (1970), 1970-11-21
discourses.quote: Develop Love, demonstrate Love, draw Love from your surrounding - that is the way to deserve leadership.

discourses.citation: No bumps, no jumps — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 13 (1975 - 77), 1975-11-15
discourses.quote: Service is the best school for training in leadership.

discourses.citation: A flower at His feet — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 10 (1970), 1970-03-04
discourses.quote: You cannot attain positions of leadership, if that is your ambition, without years of sincere seva to the people. Unless you build your career on that foundation, leadership will be but a five-year fair!

make_it_real: Swami never asked anyone to chase a title — He asked them to deserve one. Serve first, speak sweetly, and leadership will follow you.
title: Leadership

vahinis.quote: They are the exemplars and leaders for men to tread the spiritual path. Pure selfless love is inborn in women.
